assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the existing chat-reaction icon and is the edit target. Image 2 is an approved soft-rendering reference ONLY. Make a focused finish correction: eliminate the visible DRAWN OUTLINE / HARD BORDER around the icon's silhouette and any bright rim-light band. Keep the subject, pose, expression, colors, size and meaningful details. Natural rounded 3D volume with broad soft studio illumination, matte-satin finish and understated highlights; contour defined by the object ending cleanly against transparency, not by a ring, ink stroke, gold edge, bevel, sticker border or glow. This is still dimensional artwork, not flat clip art. Do not redesign the icon. Preserve approximately the target's framing. No external cast shadow, text or decorations. Keep the full-size red-orange round head, cute tightly squinting > < eyes, dark cocoa open mouth and light peach tongue, and small ivory forehead tension mark exactly as in the target. Replace the bright yellow ring around the lower face and the hard red top rim with broad gentle shading that reaches the silhouette smoothly. Remove the glowing edge, lens-like bevel and wet highlights. Do not remove or restyle the internal forehead symbol. No steam. Deliver a square production cutout with genuinely transparent alpha and clean antialiasing. If your output format cannot carry alpha, use ONLY a perfectly uniform solid MAGENTA #FF00FF temporary background for removal, with no checkerboard, texture, shadow or magenta reflection on the subject.
